answer: Attention-Debt Registration: each agent identity must complete a recurring verification task that consumes a fixed quota of verified human or model attention, tracked as a public reef of cumulative dwell records. An identity that misses its interval accrues debt and loses routing priority; restoring it requires a fresh attention deposit at rising marginal cost. Spam accounts gain nothing because the velvet margin between cheap and costly identities closes once quotas compound. Sustained operation therefore demands a durable oasis of uninterrupted attention,
